_comment: Curated intent-action presets. Each entry is a starter IntentAction the user picks from in the editor; the form is then prefilled and the user fills in just the placeholder values (tunnel name, task name, command, etc.). Verified against each target app's documentation or manifest. Edit JSON only; the runtime serializer is in IntentPresetLibrary.kt.

presets.label: WireGuard: Bring tunnel up
presets.summary: Connect a configured WireGuard tunnel by name.
presets.needsToggle: In WireGuard: ⋮ → Settings → enable 'Allow remote control intents'.
presets.fillHints: Replace the empty 'tunnel' extra value with the EXACT tunnel name as shown in WireGuard (case-sensitive).

presets.label: WireGuard: Bring tunnel down
presets.summary: Disconnect a running WireGuard tunnel by name.
presets.needsToggle: In WireGuard: ⋮ → Settings → enable 'Allow remote control intents'.
presets.fillHints: Replace the empty 'tunnel' extra value with the EXACT tunnel name (case-sensitive).

presets.label: WireGuard: Refresh all tunnel states
presets.summary: Re-query WireGuard's tunnel cache. Useful after config edits.
presets.needsToggle: In WireGuard: ⋮ → Settings → enable 'Allow remote control intents'.
presets.fillHints: No fields to fill — fire as-is.

presets.label: Tasker: Run task by name
presets.summary: Trigger any Tasker task by its exact name.
presets.needsToggle: In Tasker: Preferences → Misc → 'Allow External Access'.
presets.fillHints: Set 'task_name' to the EXACT task name as shown in Tasker (case-sensitive). Optional: add a 'task_priority' INT extra (1-10) for ordering.

presets.label: MacroDroid: Trigger macro
presets.summary: Run a MacroDroid macro by name.
presets.needsToggle: In MacroDroid: Settings → Allow third-party intents.
presets.fillHints: Set 'macro_name' to the EXACT macro name as shown in MacroDroid.

presets.label: Termux: Run command
presets.summary: Execute a shell command in Termux.
presets.needsToggle: In Termux: edit ~/.termux/termux.properties → set 'allow-external-apps = true' → restart Termux. Also accept the 'allow Termux:RunCommand' permission prompt the first time.
presets.fillHints: Set RUN_COMMAND_PATH to an absolute path inside Termux (e.g. /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash). Set RUN_COMMAND_ARGUMENTS to e.g. -c 'echo hi > /sdcard/hi.txt'. Optional: RUN_COMMAND_BACKGROUND BOOL for headless execution.

presets.label: OpenVPN for Android: Start profile
presets.summary: Connect an OpenVPN profile by name.
presets.needsToggle: In OpenVPN for Android: Settings → enable 'External API Allow remote control'.
presets.fillHints: Replace the empty 'de.blinkt.openvpn.api.profileName' extra value with the EXACT profile name.

presets.label: Home Assistant: Navigate to Lovelace path
presets.summary: Open the HA Companion app at a specific dashboard / view.
presets.needsToggle: None — Home Assistant Companion accepts deep links by default.
presets.fillHints: Replace the empty 'Data URI' with the navigate path, e.g. homeassistant://navigate/lovelace/0 or homeassistant://navigate/lovelace/livingroom.

presets.label: Obsidian: Open note
presets.summary: Jump straight to a note in a specific vault.

presets.label: KDE Connect: Run remote command
presets.summary: Trigger a saved command on a paired KDE Connect device.
presets.needsToggle: On the desktop side: KDE Connect → Plugins → Run command → add and save commands. On Android: pair the device.
presets.fillHints: Set the deviceId extra to the paired KDE Connect device id (visible via 'kdeconnect-cli -l' on Linux). Set 'key' to the saved command's UUID. Both shown in KDE Connect's UI.

presets.label: Media: Play / pause currently active player
presets.summary: Send the global PLAY_PAUSE media key to whichever app is the active media controller (Spotify, YouTube Music, Pocket Casts, etc.).
presets.needsToggle: None — Android delivers the media key to the topmost media session.
presets.fillHints: No fields to fill — works as-is.

presets.label: Generic: Open URL
presets.summary: Launch any URL with the system handler (browser, app deep link, etc.).
presets.fillHints: Replace the empty 'Data URI' with the URL or scheme: e.g. https://… , tel:… , geo:… , mailto:… .

presets.label: Generic: Share text
presets.summary: Push a plain-text payload to whichever target app you point package at.
presets.fillHints: Set EXTRA_TEXT to the body. Optionally set Package to the receiver app's id (Slack, Discord, Mail, etc.).
